tasks.title: Frame observable outcome
tasks.goal: Define user/system outcome, acceptance criteria, non-goals, risk and verification strategy before implementation.
acceptance: Acceptance criteria are observable and falsifiable.
Non-goals and rollback/escalation conditions are explicit.
verification: Review the work contract or exec plan for outcome, evidence and risk.

tasks.title: Map existing system
tasks.goal: Trace relevant code, tests, history, runtime surfaces and ownership before design decisions.
acceptance: Relevant entry points, dependencies and existing patterns are identified.
Unknowns capable of changing the design are resolved or explicitly listed.
verification: Cite repository paths and runtime surfaces in the task packet.

tasks.title: Set architecture contract
tasks.goal: Define boundaries, data shapes, state ownership, dependency direction, failure semantics and migration behavior.
acceptance: The design uses the smallest sufficient mechanism.
verification: Review architecture decision against repository dependency rules and existing contracts.

tasks.title: Establish tests or behavioral baseline
tasks.goal: Create a failing contract test or capture a measurable pre-change baseline before implementation where practical.
acceptance: The proof targets the requested contract rather than incidental implementation details.
verification: Run the focused test or baseline recipe and store evidence.

tasks.title: Implement smallest coherent feature slice
tasks.goal: Implement the agreed behavior without unrelated refactoring or speculative architecture.
acceptance: Requested behavior is implemented within agreed boundaries.
verification: Inspect the diff against the architecture contract and acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Run deterministic gates
tasks.goal: Run relevant formatting, type, lint, unit, integration and architecture checks.
acceptance: All relevant deterministic gates pass or the task remains blocked.
verification: Capture exact commands and passing output in structured evidence.

tasks.title: Prove real product behavior
tasks.goal: Operate the real UI, API, CLI or closest faithful environment and prove the user/system outcome plus side effects.
acceptance: Every user-facing acceptance criterion has runtime evidence.
Important side effects are verified independently of visible output.
verification: Use the feature map or runtime-verification skill and produce evidence JSON.

tasks.title: Try to falsify the change
tasks.goal: Challenge correctness, blast radius, boundary cases, security, retries, migrations and verification gaps.
acceptance: Blocking findings are explicit and evidence-backed.
If no issue is found, attempted counterexamples are recorded.
verification: Review findings against actual ref and test/runtime evidence.

tasks.title: Resolve findings and close out
tasks.goal: Resolve blocking review findings, rerun affected gates and prepare evidence-backed integration.
acceptance: Every acceptance criterion maps to passing evidence.
Residual uncertainty and follow-up work are explicit.
verification: Rerun any gate invalidated by fixes and produce final evidence.
